message.text: No GraphQL schema exists. The public API is protobuf-defined Connect/gRPC with gRPC-Gateway REST, plus HTTP routes for fileserver and RSS. I will cite the proto file locations and registration.

value.content:
# Memos API Design

This API design should follow the guidelines and best practices outlined in the [Google API Improvement Proposals (AIPs)](https://google.aip.dev/).

message.text: The answer is concise and sufficient.

r05.
There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is protobuf AIP services under `proto/api/v1/` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, and the rest). Those are served as Connect (`/memos.api.v1.*`) and gRPC-Gateway HTTP from `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`). Extra HTTP surfaces are the file server (`server/router/fileserver`) and RSS (`server/router/rss`).
